task.description: Design a fix for the flaky test TC-EXT-01-U08a in tests/unit/service_task_test.zig (GH #528 / ISS-0207). Root cause: (1) CaptureServer hardcodes TCP port 18181, a shared machine-wide resource that collides under concurrent zig build test runs / parallel workspace checkouts; (2) captured header fields (first_trace_id, first_trace_id_len, and idempotency/custom-header equivalents) are written by the CaptureServer background thread and read by the test thread at line 339 with no happens-before edge — defer server.join() runs at scope EXIT, after the assertions, so this is a data race by construction. Produce a Type E prose design (src/design/service-task-test-capture-server.md) describing: (a) CaptureServer binding an ephemeral port (port 0) and exposing the actual bound port so the test can build url_template dynamically instead of hardcoding 18181; (b) a synchronisation mechanism (e.g. a std.Thread.ResetEvent or explicit join-before-assert) establishing a happens-before edge between the server thread finishing its capture and the test thread reading the captured fields, replacing the defer-at-scope-exit pattern. Do not write implementation code — prose design only, per templates/lego-catalog.md Type E.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers ephemeral port binding + dynamic url_template construction
Design covers a happens-before synchronisation primitive between CaptureServer thread and test assertions
Design explicitly states captured-header fields must not be read from the test thread while the server thread may still write them
No implementation code present in the design artefact

result.summary: Wrote Type E prose design src/design/service-task-test-capture-server.md fixing ISS-0207/GH#528. (a) CaptureServer.port becomes a request value (0 = OS-assigned ephemeral port); new bound_port field is populated from the listener's local address inside run() right after listen() succeeds; test builds url_template dynamically from bound_port instead of the hardcoded 18181 literal. (b) Two std.Thread.ResetEvent fields (listening, headers_captured) replace reliance on defer server.join() for data visibility: run() sets listening right after bind and headers_captured right after captureRequestHeaders() returns (before respond()); the test waits on listening before reading bound_port and on headers_captured (after executeHttpRequest returns, before the first assertion) before reading first_trace_id/first_idempotency_key/first_custom_header. defer server.join() is retained but documented as thread-lifecycle cleanup only, no longer load-bearing for correctness. No implementation code included (prose/pseudocode only); lint_design_artefact.py passes with no issues.
